manifest.name: temporal-tests
manifest.description: Every top-level test of the Temporal ./tests package, generated from its test list

workload.invariant: passes through the one-box cluster under virtual time

TestClientMiscTestSuite.reason: Its choice tape overflows the 64 MiB bound on both seeds (choice_trace_overflow, darwin/arm64 2026-09-28); seed repeatability is proven without a retained success replay.

Test_Activity_Basic.reason: Measures dispatch fairness over a backlog it assumes is fully written before activity polling starts; under virtual time server work takes no time, so polling begins while later workflows' activity tasks are still in transfer and the first 40-66 dispatched tasks come from 3-4 of 15 workflows (TestFairnessSuite unfairness 1.03-1.04 on seeds 11 and 17, TestFairnessAutoEnableSuite 1.27 on seed 11, against 0.45 under stock go test; threshold 1.0, priority_fairness_test.go:603).

TestNexusStartOperation_Outcomes.reason: Its ByNamespaceAndTaskQueue and ByEndpoint subtests run in parallel on one shared cluster and register the same endpoint name (tc.endpointName, nexus_api_test.go:275); stock go test passes only while the matching engine's in-memory endpoint registry has not yet observed the first registration, and under virtual time it has, so CreateNexusEndpoint returns AlreadyExists.

TestOperation.reason: Needs two dedicated clusters at once (nexus_otel_test.go:142-143); testcore sizes the dedicated pool from GOMAXPROCS, which Gomad pins to 1, so the test waits on its own slot forever. Stock go test hangs the same way with TEMPORAL_TEST_DEDICATED_CLUSTERS=1, and the deterministic profile does not pass target environment to the program.

TestNexusOperationSurvivesResetCrossTree.reason: Asserts the reset run's exact history with the done signal after the post-reset workflow task completes; the test sends the signal without waiting for that task, and under virtual time it lands first and is buffered into it (16 events instead of 19, nexus_workflow_test.go:3693).

TestScheduleMigrationV2ToV1Idempotent.reason: Expects a second MigrateSchedule to succeed, but Scheduler.MigrateToWorkflow is idempotent only while the migration is pending and returns ErrClosed once its side-effect task closed the CHASM schedule; stock go test passes only while that task has not run yet (chasm/lib/scheduler/scheduler.go:817).

TestScheduleV1.reason: Its choice tape overflows the 64 MiB bound (choice_trace_overflow, darwin/arm64 2026-09-29); seed repeatability is proven without a retained success replay.

TestScheduleV1WorkflowPauseInteraction.reason: Its choice tape overflows the 64 MiB bound (choice_trace_overflow, darwin/arm64 2026-09-29); seed repeatability is proven without a retained success replay.

TestStartDelay/UpdateWhilePaused_AfterWi.reason: Under the forward clock tick a deadline propagated over gRPC lands a few microseconds later on the server than on the client, because time.Now runs ahead of the timer clock by the accumulated draws; the 3s long poll then hits the client's context deadline before the server returns its empty response (seed 11; seed 17 passes). The suite runs under forward because that removes eleven timestamp-tie skips.

TestVersioningFunctionalSuite.reason: Its choice tape overflows the 64 MiB bound (choice_trace_overflow, darwin/arm64 2026-09-29); seed repeatability is proven without a retained success replay. Its WAL-mode SQLite database grows past 16 MiB, which the in-memory filesystem refused until 2026-09-29; with the raised bound a repetition runs the whole suite in about 20 minutes of wall time on darwin/arm64, so it needs the longer budgets. TestDescribeTaskQueueEnhanced_ReportFlags fails deterministically on both seeds under Gomad and is not yet shown to be a test bug; open finding recorded in F7's status (2026-09-29).

TestWFTFailureReportedProblems_NotCleare.reason: The SDK logs the forced workflow panic with a goroutine traceback, and the traceback prints dead argument slots (values marked ?) that hold host thread-stack addresses, so the log differs between same-seed runs (seed 17). The runtime traceback is outside the patch allowlist; follow-up to mask dead slots under Gomad.

TestDispatchCancelOnWorkflowTimeout.reason: Seed 11 never delivers the cancel command to the worker control queue within the 120s wait after the workflow times out ("Context timeout is too short" on each poll, worker_commands_task_test.go:467); seed 17 delivers it. Schedule-dependent delivery; needs a server-side investigation of the cancel dispatch after workflow timeout.

TestWorkflowTaskHeartbeatingWithEmptyRes.reason: Counts workflow task timeouts over twelve 1s sleeps and expects two; the second timeout only fires because each RespondWorkflowTaskCompleted round trip adds wall time, and under virtual time the twelve sleeps span exactly 12s and one timeout fires (workflow_task_test.go:110).

TestSignalWorkflowTestSuiteChasm.reason: Residual replay divergence: about 1 in 28 seed-11 replays differ in stderr (two heap-span refills swap order before any collection; allocating goroutine not yet identified). Open Gomad finding recorded in F7's status (2026-09-29).

TestTaskQueueStats_Pri_Suite.reason: Its I/O transcript overflows the 64 MiB bound (terminal state overflow, reported as "I/O transcript did not complete", darwin/arm64 2026-09-29, both seeds). The bound is fixed in deterministicio.MaximumTranscriptBytes and the runtime rejects a larger mapping (invalid terminal frame at 256 MiB), so qualifying it needs a coordinated runner and runtime capacity change (follow-up).
